title: Starship adventure
tagline: Wake up aboard a starship and find your way home.
teaser: A text adventure that starts aboard a starship and leads to a tropical world. Explore, collect and puzzle your way out.

manPage.synopsis: battlestar — type what you want to do: explore, take, use, escape.
manPage.description: David Riggle wrote the original in 1979 to try out the C language, with help from Chris Guthrie, Peter Da Silva, Kevin Brown and Edward Wang.

howToPlay: Type short commands like "go north" or "take lamp".
Explore the ship, collect useful things and solve puzzles.
Find your way off the ship and to the island.
